description:
Your coding agents don't stop when you leave the desk, so neither should you. Tailscode puts every agent running on your own computers in your pocket: Claude Code, Hermes, opencode and Oh My Pi, plus any agent that speaks the Agent Client Protocol, on any model they can run, including one on your own graphics card. Start a task from the couch, check on six at once from anywhere, and get a ping when the long one finishes. Your chats go straight to your machines over your own Tailscale network, never through a relay, with no sign-in. Free and open source.

ONE COMMAND TO SET UP
For Claude Code, one line on the computer you code on installs the bridge and ends with a QR code. Scan it, confirm, and the app has your machine; opencode has a one-line installer too. Want to look first? A built-in demo shows the main screens with no server at all.

HERMES AND ANY ACP AGENT
• Hermes, Gemini CLI, Codex, goose and the rest of the ACP registry run through the bridge already on your machine, each proved with a real chat before it counts as ready.
• Hermes with no model gets one in a tap from the model server your machine already runs. It sits in the model pill beside Claude.
• Hold Send to ask later, or type when: weekdays 7:30. Your machine asks with your phone off, remembers the last run and stays quiet when nothing changed.

EVERY AGENT AT A GLANCE
• Home is one ranked board: a sentence that says who needs you and what is working, then the chats waiting on you, working, pinned and recent.
• The Agents board shows what needs you, what is working, what runs in the background and what finished in the last hour, with approve and answer on each card. Watch turns it into a full-screen wall of every agent.

ANY MODEL, EVEN YOUR OWN GPU
• Whatever your agent can run, from cloud models to a local model served by Ollama or llama.cpp on your own machine, picked per chat with its reasoning effort.
• Carry a conversation to another model: the next one gets a short brief of the chat and picks up the thread.
• A party of six favourite models and their effort levels, one tap or one swipe of the model pill away.

LONG RUNS, NO BABYSITTING
• A Live Activity on your Lock Screen for a running conversation, one for each with Pro: what it is doing, for how long, and how many tools it has run.
• Notifications say how long a turn took and what it changed. Reply from the Lock Screen; an approval shows the exact command and asks for Face ID.
• Queue the next message while a turn runs, edit it before it goes, or stop the turn on the server.

A NATIVE TRANSCRIPT, NOT A TERMINAL
• Megatron folds a turn's thinking and tool runs into one head you open to read, search and replay every step.
• Diffs, commands and their real output inline; syntax-highlighted code with byte-exact copy.

KNOW WHAT IT COSTS
• Every conversation priced, every month totalled across machines, by model, project and tool. Always an estimate, never a bill.
• Plan limits and quotas per provider and account, with the pace and turns left, on Home and in widgets.

YOURS, END TO END
• Your chats travel point to point over your tailnet, never through a relay. No sign-in, no ads, no tracking, and your code and conversations never reach us.
• iPhone, iPad and Mac, plus a Linux desktop app, all open source under GPL-3.0: the app, the engine and the bridges.

FREE, WITH AN HONEST PRO
The free app is the complete core on one server: full chat, the Agents and Home boards, approvals, attachments, every model, a Live Activity at a time. Tailscode Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription: unlimited servers in one list, concurrent Live Activities, iPhone and Mac on the same Apple Account, the delegate board, and a supporter heart.

Tailscode is independent open-source software, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, Nous Research, Tailscale Inc., the opencode project or Oh My Pi.

Privacy policy: https://midgarcorp.cc/tailscode/privacy
Source code: https://github.com/guitaripod/Tailscode
promotionalText: Run Claude Code, Hermes, opencode and any ACP agent on your own computers, on any model, even your own GPU, and have your machine ask on a schedule. No sign-in.
whatsNew:
New:
• Any agent. Hermes, Gemini CLI, Codex, goose and every other agent that speaks the Agent Client Protocol now run through the claude-bridge already on your machine and appear in the model pill. Open your server to add one: the machine proves each agent with a real chat, gives Hermes a brain from the models it already runs with one tap, and keeps keys on the machine.
• Ask later, kept by your machine. Hold Send and pick a time, or type one like “weekdays 7:30”. The machine asks whether or not this device is on, keeps one conversation that remembers, stays quiet when nothing changed, and says when it missed a run. Scheduled lists every machine's schedules and how each run went.

Agents need claude-bridge 1.17; schedules need claude-bridge 1.17 or omp-bridge 0.10.
